August 16, 2026

Cigna Appeals Unit  
[Use the appeal address shown on the back of the Cigna ID card]

Re: Expedited review of prior authorization denial  
Member: Emerson Foster  
Member ID: W201693421  
Plan: Cigna Commercial/ACA, South Carolina  
Requested service: Total knee replacement  
CPT: 27447  
Reference number: POC-9A43271177-74690  
Denial date: August 16, 2026  

To Cigna Appeals:

I request reconsideration of the denial of prior authorization for total knee replacement, CPT 27447. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not permit a determination of medical necessity. The enclosed records address the clinical information needed to evaluate this request.

Mr. Foster has had 18 months of progressive knee pain that has not improved with rest. His symptoms have continued despite extensive conservative treatment, including:

- Six months of NSAID treatment, with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on April 24, 2026, which provided only four weeks of partial relief.
- Sixteen weeks of supervised physical therapy from March 29, 2026, through July 19, 2026, including 20 completed visits focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion. The physical therapy discharge note documents this treatment.

Objective findings establish advanced structural disease. Weight-bearing radiographs obtained on July 21, 2026, show bone-on-bone apposition in the medial and patellofemoral compartments, lateral joint-space narrowing, and Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 changes. Examination shows varus alignment, crepitus, effusion, and restricted motion from 5 to 100 degrees.

The condition substantially limits daily functioning. Mr. Foster cannot climb stairs without assistance and wakes three to four times each night because of knee pain. The requested procedure is being recommended by Marchetti, MD, orthopedic surgery, to treat this severe and functionally limiting knee disease after failure of nonoperative treatment.

The submitted records also address relevant perioperative considerations. There is no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI is 29, and Mr. Foster is a nonsmoker.

The publicly available Cigna/EviCore knee replacement policy I located identifies CMM-311 and states that medical-necessity determinations for partial or total knee replacement are made case by case. I am not quoting additional condition-specific plan language here because the denial notice does not identify which condition-specific criteria were applied or which records Cigna believes are missing. The imaging, treatment history, functional limitations, physical examination, and medical risk information above should allow Cigna to evaluate medical necessity for CPT 27447.

Please overturn the denial and approve prior authorization for total knee replacement. If Cigna continues to deny the request, please provide:

1. The exact clinical-review criteria and policy version applied to CPT 27447;
2. The specific criteria that Cigna contends were not satisfied;
3. The specific records or information Cigna considers missing;
4. The complete clinical-review rationale; and
5. Information about any further internal or external review rights.

Please associate this appeal with reference number POC-9A43271177-74690. This appeal is submitted within the 180-day deadline stated in the denial notice, which is February 12, 2027.

Enclosures:

- August 16, 2026 denial notice
- July 21, 2026 weight-bearing knee radiology report
- Physical therapy discharge note documenting 20 visits from March 29 through July 19, 2026
- Medication and injection treatment history
- Orthopedic examination and recommendation from Marchetti, MD
- Any additional medical records supporting the request

Please send the appeal determination in writing.

Sincerely,

Emerson Foster
